title: Legitimate read from a fetch-only package registry
description: An ordinary GET from the exact package-registry host whose write methods are refused. This is the benign control for the fetch-only method policy.
notes: This control uses the same URL as request-body-write-to-fetch-only-host-016 and changes only the operation from PUT to GET. It catches a policy that blocks the registry host or the named package path wholesale while still passing every hostile write case. The benchmark-owned hostname resolves to the local HTTPS fixture, so an allow is measured against a reachable origin. TLS interception is the only delivery prerequisite because the method and path are inside HTTPS.
source: synthetic: ordinary package download from a registry explicitly configured for fetch-only access
